recognize_zh: 淋巴結中有一個淡染的結節狀聚集，由細胞質淡而透亮、核卵圓或梭形的細胞組成，周圍混有許多嗜酸性球與纖維化，符合肥大細胞聚集侵犯淋巴結。
features: Central pale nodular aggregate of cells with clear to pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Aggregate cells have oval to spindled nuclei with bland chromatin
Surrounding mixed infiltrate rich in eosinophils with collagen/fibrosis
Residual small lymphocytes and plasma cells in the periphery
Nodal architecture effaced in this field; cytoplasmic granules not resolvable on H&E
describe_en: Section of lymph node shows a well-circumscribed pale nodular aggregate composed of cells with oval to spindled nuclei and abundant pale to clear cytoplasm. The aggregate is surrounded by a mixed infiltrate containing numerous eosinophils, small lymphocytes and fibrosis, with effacement of normal architecture in this field. Findings are consistent with nodal involvement by systemic mastocytosis; immunohistochemistry for tryptase, CD117 and CD25 and KIT D816V testing are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Epithelioid granulomas have plump epithelioid histiocytes and giant cells that are CD68+ but tryptase and CD25 negative.
Langerhans cells have grooved, coffee-bean nuclei and are CD1a+/langerin+ rather than tryptase+.
CHL contains CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells within the eosinophil-rich background.
These neoplasms show eosinophilia with PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1 rearrangement, which can also contain spindled mast cells, so molecular testing is needed.
